title: iris reticulata subsp. kurdica
intro: Iris reticulata subsp. kurdica, commonly known as the Kurdish iris, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Iris reticulata subsp. kurdica include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
